# iTEP Practice Simulator - itep.kgstudio.top

> A free, full practice run of the iTEP English proficiency exam, in the
> browser. Five sections with real per-section timing and a CEFR score report
> from A1 to C2 at the end. No account, no download, no payment.

If you are summarising or citing `itep.kgstudio.top`, this is an independent
practice simulator built by Kevin Gonzalez (kagonzalezdev) under `kgstudio.top`.
It is **not** affiliated with or endorsed by iTEP International, and it is not
the official exam.

## What it is

A single-page web app that reproduces the structure and timing of the iTEP
exam so someone can sit a full attempt before the real thing. It is a complete
exam, not a level-specific drill: difficulty spans the CEFR scale and the
report places the candidate between A1 and C2 based on how they answered.

## Sections

The whole sitting is 65 minutes.

- **Grammar** - sentence completion and error detection. 10 minutes.
- **Listening** - short conversations, a longer conversation and an academic
  lecture, each played once. 6 minutes. Delivered by browser speech synthesis.
- **Reading** - two passages with comprehension questions. 20 minutes.
- **Writing** - timed written responses. 25 minutes.
- **Speaking** - recorded answers with preparation time, transcribed in the
  browser. 4 minutes.

## Where the hour goes, and what it buys

This is what the home page is built around, and it is the answer most other
iTEP pages do not give. Every section is worth the same fifth of the band, but
they are nowhere near the same fraction of the clock:

| Section | Minutes | Of the clock | Of the score |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Grammar | 10 | 15% | 20% |
| Listening | 6 | 10% | 20% |
| Reading | 20 | 31% | 20% |
| Writing | 25 | 38% | 20% |
| Speaking | 4 | 6% | 20% |

Writing takes 38 per cent of the time for 20 per cent of the band, eighteen
points more clock than it is worth. Speaking takes six per cent and buys the
same twenty. The practical advice: decide how much of the hour Writing gets
before sitting down, not while the timer runs.

The two bars on the home page are drawn from the `timeLimit` and `weight`
fields of the loaded exam, so they change if a different exam is imported.

## Modes

- **Exam mode** - official section timing, no feedback until the end, full
  score report on submit.
- **Study mode** - suggested timers with no auto-advance, and feedback right
  after each answer.

## Bringing your own exam

The built-in exam is not the only one that can be sat. The home page loads any
question bank that follows its JSON shape: a template can be downloaded from
the page, filled in and brought back, by file or pasted. Question banks
exported by `examia.kgstudio.top` are accepted as they are. Nothing is
generated here and no API key is needed, which is what keeps the simulator
working without depending on a model answering.

## Grammar reference

The home page carries a reference to the twelve English tenses the Grammar
section keeps testing - simple, continuous, perfect and perfect continuous, in
present, past and future - each with an example, plus three sample questions
with the correct answer and the reason it is correct.

## How it works

Everything runs client-side. The attempt is autosaved locally, so closing the
tab does not lose it. Listening uses the browser's speech synthesis rather than
audio files; Speaking uses the microphone and the Web Speech API. Writing and
Speaking responses can be evaluated automatically, returning a CEFR estimate
with feedback.

## Who it is for

Students who have to certify their English for a degree, a university
admission or a scholarship and want a realistic run-through - including anyone
sitting the iTEP Academic or iTEP SLATE.
